test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Indian bank become the first to launch near-real-time, 24/7 programmable USD clearing capabilities using JP Morgan’s Kinexys Digital Payments platform in March 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Axis Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Axis Bank** became the first Indian bank to launch **near-real-time, 24/7 programmable USD clearing capabilities** using JP Morgan’s **Kinexys Digital Payments platform** in **March 2025**.
 
• This innovative capability enables **instant and automated cross-border payments**, enhancing global financial connectivity.
 
• The partnership with JP Morgan underscores **Axis Bank’s commitment to leveraging technology** for providing seamless financial solutions to its customers.
 
• The **Kinexys Digital Payments platform** is known for its robust infrastructure that supports **high-speed and secure payment processing**.
 
• This move positions Axis Bank as a leader in **digital banking innovation** in India.
 
• The service is particularly beneficial for businesses engaged in **international trade**, enabling faster and more efficient transactions.
 
• This advancement aligns with the global trend of adopting **programmable payments** to enhance operational efficiency.
 
• It also reflects the growing importance of **24/7 banking services** in today’s fast-paced financial environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **State Bank of India**__

 __
 
• **State Bank of India (SBI)** is India's largest public sector bank, headquartered in **Mumbai**.
 
• SBI is known for its extensive network of branches and providing a diverse range of financial services.
 
• It serves customers across urban and rural areas and is instrumental in driving **financial inclusion** in India.
 
 
 
• **Bandhan Bank**__
 __
 
• **Bandhan Bank** is a relatively new private sector bank headquartered in **Kolkata, India**.
 
• The bank primarily focuses on providing banking services to the **underprivileged and rural population**.
 
• It began operations in 2015 and specializes in **microfinance**.
 
 
 
• **Indian Bank**__
 
 
• **Indian Bank** is a prominent public sector bank headquartered in **Chennai, India**.
 
• The bank offers a range of services including retail banking, corporate banking, and treasury operations.
 
• It merged with **Allahabad Bank** in 2020 to expand its reach and services.
